newsitem.title: USA: US Mid-Atlantic next-day power off on unit returns.
newsitem.headline: US Mid-Atlantic next-day power off on unit returns.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices for Wednesday delivery in the U.S. Mid-Atlantic softened Tuesday amid several large fossil-fueled units in the region returning to operation, market sources said.
More generation capacity and "pretty low load" pressured next-day power lower in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool, one regional trader said.

Currently, at least four PJM power plants, with combined capacity close to 2,500 megawatts (MW). were scheduled to resume operation in the next 48 hours. They were shut last weekend for repairs or maintenance.
